window_reasoning.interpretation: The CPU helper is needed only through its prefix preflight, not throughout prefix GPU compute. With a fixed60min GPU job and1950s final prefix floor, any admitted prefix enters by initialGPUstart+1650s (or earlier if currentEnd shortens). A60min helper has3540s before its own60s reserve. Thus a GPU start within roughly1890s of helper start can cover that latest entry in principle; activation, publication, queue uncertainty, shortened leases and proof failures reduce usable margin. This is alignment guidance, never a guarantee or permission to extend/retry.
